# Irrigation zones (`irrigation-zones`)

Watering zones with durations, the zone running now, the next run, and a skip for rain.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createIrrigationZones` (types in `dist/web/home/rooms/irrigationZones.d.ts`): `.mh-irrigation-zones` (on a `.mh-control-card` frame, lit in the cool colour while watering): the state line (running zone and time left, or the next run), `__now` with the running zone's progress and a stop button, a rain switch (`__rain`, with the note as its description) and `__zones`, one row per zone with its run time and a run (or stop) button. States `.is-running`, `.is-skipping`.

```ts
export function createIrrigationZones(options: IrrigationZonesOptions): IrrigationZonesHandle;

export interface IrrigationZonesOptions {
  /** The system's name ("Garden"); also the card's accessible name. */
  name: string;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  zones: readonly IrrigationZone[];
  running?: IrrigationRun | null;
  /** The next planned run, as the app formats it ("Tomorrow 06:00"). */
  nextRun?: string | null;
  /** The next run is skipped because of rain. */
  rainSkip?: boolean;
  /** Why, or the forecast, under the switch ("8 mm expected tonight"). */
  rainNote?: string;
  labels?: Partial<IrrigationZonesLabels>;
  unavailable?: boolean;
  /** Start one zone now (a running zone stops first). */
  onRun?: (id: string) => void;
  onStop?: () => void;
  /** Shows the rain switch. */
  onRainSkip?: (skip: boolean) => void;
}

export interface IrrigationZonesHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  update(changes: Partial<IrrigationZonesOptions>): void;
}

/** Every visible or spoken word, for translation. */
export interface IrrigationZonesLabels {
  /** "Watering Lawn". */
  watering(zone: string): string;
  /** "6 min left". */
  left(time: string): string;
  /** "Next run Tomorrow 06:00". */
  next(when: string): string;
  skipped: string;
  idle: string;
  /** "Run Lawn". */
  run(zone: string): string;
  stop: string;
  rainSkip: string;
  zones: string;
  progress: string;
  /** "10 min". */
  minutes(n: number): string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createIrrigationZones, type IrrigationRun, type IrrigationZone } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

// Durations are in minutes.
const zones: IrrigationZone[] = [
  { id: 'lawn', name: 'Front lawn', duration: 20 },
  { id: 'beds', name: 'Flower beds', duration: 10 },
  { id: 'veg', name: 'Vegetable patch', duration: 15 },
];

let running: IrrigationRun | null = null;

const garden = createIrrigationZones({
  name: 'Garden watering',
  zones,
  nextRun: 'Tomorrow 06:00',
  rainNote: '6 mm of rain expected tonight',
  onRun: (id) => {
    running = { zone: id, remaining: zones.find((z) => z.id === id)!.duration * 60 };
    garden.update({ running });
  },
  onStop: () => garden.update({ running: (running = null) }),
  onRainSkip: (rainSkip) => garden.update({ rainSkip }),
});

setInterval(() => {
  if (!running) return;
  running = running.remaining > 1 ? { ...running, remaining: running.remaining - 1 } : null;
  garden.update({ running });
}, 1000);

document.body.append(garden.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { IrrigationZones } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { IrrigationRun, IrrigationZone } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

// Durations are in minutes.
const zones: IrrigationZone[] = [
  { id: 'lawn', name: 'Front lawn', duration: 20 },
  { id: 'beds', name: 'Flower beds', duration: 10 },
  { id: 'veg', name: 'Vegetable patch', duration: 15 },
];

export function IrrigationZonesExample() {
  const [running, setRunning] = useState<IrrigationRun | null>(null);
  const [rainSkip, setRainSkip] = useState(false);
  const watering = running !== null;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!watering) return;
    const tick = setInterval(
      () => setRunning((r) => (r && r.remaining > 1 ? { ...r, remaining: r.remaining - 1 } : null)),
      1000,
    );
    return () => clearInterval(tick);
  }, [watering]);

  return (
    <IrrigationZones
      name="Garden watering"
      zones={zones}
      running={running}
      nextRun="Tomorrow 06:00"
      rainSkip={rainSkip}
      rainNote="6 mm of rain expected tonight"
      onRun={(id) => setRunning({ zone: id, remaining: zones.find((z) => z.id === id)!.duration * 60 })}
      onStop={() => setRunning(null)}
      onRainSkip={setRainSkip}
    />
  );
}
```
